title: Void invoice
purpose: Record why an issued invoice is void and keep its number, original PDF and history.
summary: Record why an issued invoice is void. It keeps its number and original PDF, and you can prepare a new draft from the chain of custody.

tasks.title: Void the issued invoice
steps: Check the invoice number and enter [[Reason for voiding]].

tasks.title: Prepare a replacement
steps: On the voided record, open the linked [[Chain of custody]].
Select [[New draft invoice]] to review the order’s current tests and pricing sources.

good_to_know: Voiding closes the accounting CSV download. If you already posted the charges, reconcile the void in your ledger. The original PDF stays available.
A void records who took the action, when and why.
The action requires a current issued invoice. Reload the record if its status has changed.

sections.title: Access and actions
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators can view this form or submit the void. The invoice must be issued. Direct links for other invoice states return to the invoice record.

items.label: Keep the original invoice
items.description: Identifies the invoice being voided. The number is retired with that document, and the original PDF, amounts, source draft and history remain readable.

items.label: Reason for voiding
items.description: Required explanation, up to 2,000 characters. It is saved with the void time and responsible staff account.

items.label: Void invoice
items.description: Rechecks the invoice's state and revision before recording a void. The attributed history event and state change are saved together. The order is then available for a fresh draft, subject to draft eligibility. The accounting CSV closes. Staff handle any correction to previously exported charges in the ledger.

items.label: Field and form errors
items.description: The form keeps the entered reason when validation fails. Review the invoice's current state if another staff member has voided it.

items.label: Cancel / Close form
items.description: Leave the invoice unchanged. A dialog with unsaved changes offers Keep editing or Discard changes.

items.label: Draft invoices / Invoice number
items.description: Breadcrumb links return to the staff directory or invoice record.
